page0.text:
...No, I can't stop. Not now.
No matter how strong it may be, if it doesn't hit me, it won't matter.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-04:page0:1

page1.text:
The three blades come at me like a blast of wind.
"YOU'RE the idiot, Shinji!!!"
This attack is nothing compared to Saber's—
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-04:page1:1

page2.text:
"Gh—!?"
I pass through the gaps between the three overlapping shadows.
I don't feel any danger from the shadows.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-04:page2:1

page3.text:
There's no problem then.
Saber taught me that I shouldn't hesitate as long as I don't sense that the attack will be fatal.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-04:page3:1
